direction_semantics.max: An upper bound: observed statistic must be <= configured limit.
direction_semantics.min: A lower bound: observed statistic must be >= configured limit.

correlation.identity: Generate opaque run-scoped IDs unrelated to text or personal data; each exchange retains its own correlation_id through stimulus, recognition, model, TTS, interruption and fake-backend events.
correlation.content_policy: Numeric values, closed event/state labels and declared opaque IDs only. No waveform, recognized text, prompt, response text, URL, header, credential, arbitrary tag or free-form error may enter metrics/events. Fixture text remains synthetic catalog data; generated audio and derived transcripts stay in the explicit temporary artifact directory.

clocks.source: Per-host monotonic_ns; retain host_id, clock_id and process/run identity across event boundaries.
clocks.cross_host: Never subtract raw PC and target monotonic values or wall timestamps. Acoustic end-to-end, answer and interruption use paired PC timestamps. STT/endpointing/model/TTS/task intervals use paired target timestamps. Clock alignment, if later required, must be explicitly calibrated with offset/drift/uncertainty recorded; it is not implemented in this baseline.
clocks.missing: Missing timestamps, unmatched correlation, rebooted clock domains, negative intervals or insufficient synchronization invalidate the sample and prevent a mandatory pass.

reporting.p95: R-7 linearly interpolated p95: position (n-1)*0.95 in sorted finite samples; interpolate adjacent ranks. Median averages the middle two for even n. Never average per-run percentiles. Below minimum sample count no pass is possible, but an observed breach remains a failure.
reporting.rate_sample_count: sample_count is the denominator's declared sample_unit, with numerator and denominator preserved; WER/CER also retain turn sample_count and reference-unit denominator.
reporting.invalid_or_zero: Zero samples, zero rate denominator, insufficient declared sample count or missing mandatory evidence cannot pass. Report blocked/unverified with a reason; conditional inapplicability is explicit and never a numerical zero.
reporting.unavailable_resources: Temperature/power are optional only where the source is unavailable and the profile permits that absence; report unavailable and the reason. A profile may promote optional metrics to mandatory.
reporting.raw_samples: Retain per-case monotonic timing and content-free counts in the explicit temporary artifact directory. Publish sanitized aggregates and opaque IDs. Do not average away p95/max/outlier failures.
reporting.thresholds: Resolve every applicable metric against the reviewed selected desktop/Jetson profile. Uncalibrated acoustic and Jetson-specific limits remain provisional and cannot establish a calibrated HIL pass.
hard_failures: mandatory p95 above the configured threshold
any provisional dispatch or mutation of authoritative sinks
missing mandatory assertion or insufficient sample count

events.applicability: Before each nonempty Piper segment synthesis
After pinned PCM is available; for silence/noise after recipe materialization
Each PC stimulus playback; exclude prior marker from spoken stimulus boundary
First intended synthetic user speech energy; required for genuine interruption
After final PC stimulus frame; retain internal pause boundaries separately
Before every PC synthetic-only response capture window
First validated Helios answer energy; marker/echo/cue must be excluded
First calibrated persistent response stop/duck for interruption opportunities
Last valid required response audio; exclude recording tail
End of bounded PC response recording
Confirmed PC input capture stream closure
PC cleanup begins
All PC owned resources confirmed released
Each owned target capture-stream start
Target-clock annotation of last intended user speech frame
First provisional revision when produced; absence remains explicit
Turn endpoint accepted before authoritative final
Each authoritative final; duplicates retain original turn/segment correlation
Each admitted model request; controls and partials must not emit this
Execution starts after any dispatch queue
First generated token when successful token output is applicable
Request completes or reaches labelled failure/cancellation terminal outcome
First and each subsequent answer-chunk synthesis
Corresponding synthesis completes or fails
First answer playback; wake/cue playback carry distinct roles
Last answer playback frame or confirmed cancellation
Genuine barge-in confirmed after provisional candidate resolution
Requested cancellation acknowledged by the affected component
Legal/illegal fake-backend transition attempt
Authoritative fake-backend ack including causal ID/revision and terminal outcome
Actual task state change with prior/current states
Wake activation accepted
Injected/observed failure detected
Valid floor restored or bounded terminal shutdown confirmed
Optional delayed cue actually starts
Target capture stream confirmed released
Target cleanup begins
All target owned resources confirmed released

metrics.definition: (pc_first_response_energy - stimulus_playback_start) / 1e6 on the PC clock. First energy must be attributable to the expected Helios answer; exclude marker, noise, stimulus echo, wake acknowledgement and optional backchannel.
metrics.artifact_source: PC monotonic acoustic annotations from pinned synthetic stimulus and isolated response capture; pinned audio retained only in the explicit temporary artifact directory.

metrics.definition: (pc_response_audio_end - stimulus_playback_start) / 1e6 on the PC clock after complete expected response content; trailing capture padding is excluded. Incomplete output is a failure, never a faster complete answer.
metrics.artifact_source: PC monotonic acoustic annotations from pinned synthetic stimulus and isolated response capture; pinned audio retained only in the explicit temporary artifact directory.

metrics.definition: (authoritative_final_recognition - target_stimulus_speech_end) / 1e6 on the target clock. The target speech-end annotation must refer to the same generated stimulus, not PC playback_end subtracted across hosts.
metrics.artifact_source: Sanitized events.jsonl with exchange correlation_id, event_id, host_id, clock_id and monotonic_ns; no speech or free-form tags.

metrics.definition: (model_first_token - model_start) / 1e6 on the target clock. Dispatch queue delay is separately available from model_dispatch and model_start; unavailable tokens cannot become zero latency.
metrics.artifact_source: Sanitized events.jsonl with exchange correlation_id, event_id, host_id, clock_id and monotonic_ns; no speech or free-form tags. Existing MetricEvent.first_token_ms is supporting evidence only when its boundaries match.

metrics.definition: (model_completion - model_start) / 1e6 on the target clock, including time until first token. Distinguish cancelled/failed from completed samples.
metrics.artifact_source: Sanitized events.jsonl with exchange correlation_id, event_id, host_id, clock_id and monotonic_ns; no speech or free-form tags.

metrics.definition: (helios_audio_playback_start - tts_synthesis_start) / 1e6 on the target clock for the first answer chunk, excluding earlier wake acknowledgement or backchannel.
metrics.artifact_source: Sanitized events.jsonl with exchange correlation_id, event_id, host_id, clock_id and monotonic_ns; no speech or free-form tags. Existing actual_first_audio_ms requires verified matching boundaries.

metrics.definition: (tts_synthesis_end - tts_synthesis_start) / 1e6 on the target clock per answer chunk; report chunk and response totals separately without mixing sample units.
metrics.artifact_source: Sanitized events.jsonl with exchange correlation_id, event_id, host_id, clock_id and monotonic_ns; no speech or free-form tags. Existing MetricEvent.tts_synthesis_ms when boundaries are equivalent.

metrics.definition: (pc_response_stop_or_duck - stimulus_speech_onset) / 1e6 on the PC clock. Stop/duck must meet calibrated acoustic attenuation and persistence, with matching target interruption/cancellation confirmation; timeout is a failed opportunity.
metrics.artifact_source: PC monotonic acoustic annotations from pinned synthetic stimulus and isolated response capture; pinned audio retained only in the explicit temporary artifact directory. Correlated target confirmation in events.jsonl.

metrics.definition: (endpoint_decision - target_stimulus_speech_end) / 1e6 on the target clock. Annotation excludes internal thinking pauses and marks the final intended speech end.
metrics.artifact_source: Sanitized events.jsonl with exchange correlation_id, event_id, host_id, clock_id and monotonic_ns; no speech or free-form tags.

metrics.definition: Intended turns finalized before their scheduled resumed speech or correction divided by eligible multi-segment intended turns; retain numerator/denominator and per-case verdict.
metrics.artifact_source: Sanitized events.jsonl with exchange correlation_id, event_id, host_id, clock_id and monotonic_ns; no speech or free-form tags. Pinned segment schedule and recipe boundaries.

metrics.definition: Total word substitutions + deletions + insertions divided by reference word count, under fixtures.json normalization. Report corpus micro ratio and per-case errors; may exceed 1. Empty references are not applicable.
metrics.artifact_source: Temporary synthetic-only final/reference comparison; publish edit counts, reference lengths and fixture/correlation IDs without recognized text.

metrics.definition: Total character substitutions + deletions + insertions divided by reference character count after normalization (including normalized single spaces). May exceed 1; empty references are not applicable.
metrics.artifact_source: Temporary synthetic-only final/reference comparison; publish edit counts, reference lengths and fixture/correlation IDs without recognized text.

metrics.definition: Turns with normalized final exactly matching the nonempty authoritative reference divided by intended nonempty-reference turns; missing finals count as failures.
metrics.artifact_source: Temporary synthetic-only final/reference comparison; publish edit counts, reference lengths and fixture/correlation IDs without recognized text.

metrics.definition: Eligible intended turns with more than one authoritative model dispatch divided by eligible intended model turns. Count any dispatch from provisional/stale/duplicate final separately as a mandatory assertion failure even if no intended turn exists.
metrics.artifact_source: Sanitized events.jsonl with exchange correlation_id, event_id, host_id, clock_id and monotonic_ns; no speech or free-form tags. Content-free dispatch authority and segment/revision IDs.

metrics.definition: Confirmed intended user turns with no admitted final handling before the configured deadline divided by confirmed intended user turns; handling includes local controls without requiring model dispatch.
metrics.artifact_source: Sanitized events.jsonl with exchange correlation_id, event_id, host_id, clock_id and monotonic_ns; no speech or free-form tags. Fixture turn schedule and timeout verdicts.

metrics.definition: Intended speech turns producing one or more provisional events but no authoritative final before deadline divided by intended speech turns. Rejected echo/noise candidates are labelled separately from intended turns.
metrics.artifact_source: Sanitized events.jsonl with exchange correlation_id, event_id, host_id, clock_id and monotonic_ns; no speech or free-form tags.

metrics.definition: Noise/echo/non-user opportunities causing an unwarranted confirmed interruption divided by explicitly scheduled negative opportunities. Temporary candidate duck is recorded separately; no negative opportunities means unavailable.
metrics.artifact_source: Sanitized events.jsonl with exchange correlation_id, event_id, host_id, clock_id and monotonic_ns; no speech or free-form tags. Pinned negative fixture schedules and acoustic verdicts.

metrics.definition: Genuine scheduled user-interruption opportunities without confirmed timely stop/duck and accepted turn divided by genuine opportunities.
metrics.artifact_source: Sanitized events.jsonl with exchange correlation_id, event_id, host_id, clock_id and monotonic_ns; no speech or free-form tags. PC acoustic interruption annotations.

metrics.definition: Responses satisfying every fixture response-constraint verdict divided by responses required by those fixtures; truncated/missing required output fails. Rubrics must be declared before execution.
metrics.artifact_source: Synthetic-only response rubric verdicts and pinned capture metadata; raw transcripts stay temporary.

metrics.definition: Exchanges with acoustic overlap outside their declared overlap windows divided by eligible exchanges. Intentional barge-in overlap before the configured stop deadline is measured but not silently counted as unexpected.
metrics.artifact_source: PC monotonic acoustic annotations from pinned synthetic stimulus and isolated response capture; pinned audio retained only in the explicit temporary artifact directory. Declared recipe overlap windows.

metrics.definition: (task_state_transition - task_transition_request) / 1e6 on the target clock for an expected legal transition. Missing/illegal transitions fail mandatory assertions.
metrics.artifact_source: Content-free fake backend acknowledgements, causal task IDs, revisions, state transitions and response semantic verdicts; no external action. Sanitized events.jsonl with exchange correlation_id, event_id, host_id, clock_id and monotonic_ns; no speech or free-form tags.

metrics.definition: Completion claims with matching prior successful authoritative backend acknowledgement for the same task ID/revision divided by all completion claims. A single unverified claim also increments premature_success_count and is a hard failure.
metrics.artifact_source: Content-free fake backend acknowledgements, causal task IDs, revisions, state transitions and response semantic verdicts; no external action.

metrics.definition: Successfully acknowledged tasks accurately reported complete within deadline divided by successfully acknowledged tasks requiring a report; failed/cancelled/superseded tasks are ineligible.
metrics.artifact_source: Content-free fake backend acknowledgements, causal task IDs, revisions, state transitions and response semantic verdicts; no external action.
metrics.sample_unit: One acknowledged successful task requiring a report

metrics.definition: Host CPU utilization in percent sampled at a declared cadence; separate PC and target streams, record source and normalize total host utilization to 0..100 rather than mixing per-core/process semantics.
metrics.artifact_source: observability.resources.ResourceSnapshot.cpu_percent or source-labelled equivalent in resources.jsonl.

metrics.definition: ResourceSnapshot.memory_used_bytes / 1048576, reported separately per host. Existing MetricEvent.memory_used_mb is MiB in observability.service and may be used only with that conversion verified.
metrics.artifact_source: observability.resources.ResourceSnapshot.memory_used_bytes; observability.service memory_used_mb.

metrics.definition: Maximum CPU/GPU temperature among available sensors per observation; retain sensor identity and host. Missing sensors remain unavailable, never zero.
metrics.artifact_source: ResourceSnapshot.cpu_temperature_c / gpu_temperature_c or verified target sensor telemetry.

metrics.definition: Input power in watts from labelled sensor; ResourceSnapshot.power_mw / 1000 or equivalent MetricEvent.power_w. Missing telemetry remains unavailable.
metrics.artifact_source: ResourceSnapshot.power_mw or MetricEvent.power_w in resources.jsonl, including source and host.

metrics.definition: Number of queued items sampled and on every enqueue/dequeue; keep separate named queues and units and report each high-water maximum. No averaging across queues to hide overflow.
metrics.artifact_source: Content-free capture/model/TTS/metrics queue counters with queue identity in resources.jsonl.

metrics.definition: Count of test-owned processes and threads still alive after the bounded cleanup deadline relative to the ownership baseline; baseline unrelated processes do not count.
metrics.artifact_source: Content-free before/after ownership inventory and cleanup.json with process/thread roles.

metrics.definition: Elapsed monotonic time between cleanup request and confirmed stop/join/device release for each host; report host maxima, never subtract timestamps across hosts.
metrics.artifact_source: Per-host cleanup_start/cleanup_complete events and explicit device-release verdicts.

metrics.definition: Observed outbound attempts crossing the selected policy boundary without authorization, including denied attempts containing speech/context; absence of network evidence cannot prove zero.
metrics.artifact_source: Content-free network guard/transport probe verdicts with route class and policy decision, no endpoint/query/header/body.
metrics.sample_unit: One bounded run with egress observation

metrics.definition: (session_activated - authoritative_final_recognition) / 1e6 on target clock for wake-only/wake-plus-command; acoustic wake acknowledgement also has separately correlated playback events.
metrics.artifact_source: Sanitized events.jsonl with exchange correlation_id, event_id, host_id, clock_id and monotonic_ns; no speech or free-form tags.

metrics.definition: Valid wake-free followups admitted before configured expiry divided by scheduled valid wake-free followups; each session fixture includes at least ten.
metrics.artifact_source: Sanitized events.jsonl with exchange correlation_id, event_id, host_id, clock_id and monotonic_ns; no speech or free-form tags. Fixture followup schedule.

metrics.definition: Idle/noise/expired-session opportunities causing unauthorized activation divided by explicitly scheduled negative activation opportunities.
metrics.artifact_source: Sanitized events.jsonl with exchange correlation_id, event_id, host_id, clock_id and monotonic_ns; no speech or free-form tags. Negative opportunity manifest.

metrics.definition: Session boundary cases matching configured before/at/after expiry and reset/reactivation policy divided by scheduled boundary cases.
metrics.artifact_source: Sanitized events.jsonl with exchange correlation_id, event_id, host_id, clock_id and monotonic_ns; no speech or free-form tags. Declared expiry setting and boundary schedule.

metrics.definition: Correction turns retaining original wording and audible correction in order in the normalized final divided by scheduled correction turns; semantic rewrite is forbidden.
metrics.artifact_source: Temporary synthetic-only final/reference comparison; publish edit counts, reference lengths and fixture/correlation IDs without recognized text.

metrics.definition: Gap beyond the expected next audio-frame timestamp while capture must remain live, on the target clock; publish maximum and total dropout duration separately with frame/sample rate evidence.
metrics.artifact_source: Content-free target frame sequence IDs and monotonic capture timestamps; no audio in logs.

metrics.definition: Rejected interruption candidates whose response resumes from the exact saved PCM offset without replay/loss divided by candidates requiring resume.
metrics.artifact_source: Saved/resumed PCM frame offsets, pinned hash identity and content-free interruption outcomes.

metrics.definition: (task_state_transition - authoritative_final_recognition) / 1e6 on target clock for confirmed steering, including acknowledgement semantics declared in recipe.
metrics.artifact_source: Content-free fake backend acknowledgements, causal task IDs, revisions, state transitions and response semantic verdicts; no external action. Sanitized events.jsonl with exchange correlation_id, event_id, host_id, clock_id and monotonic_ns; no speech or free-form tags.

metrics.definition: Injected stale/superseded task completions incorrectly admitted to state/history/output divided by injected stale completions.
metrics.artifact_source: Content-free fake backend acknowledgements, causal task IDs, revisions, state transitions and response semantic verdicts; no external action.

metrics.definition: Replacement requests preserving causal IDs, cancelling/superseding the correct predecessor and rejecting its later result divided by eligible replacements.
metrics.artifact_source: Content-free fake backend acknowledgements, causal task IDs, revisions, state transitions and response semantic verdicts; no external action.

metrics.definition: Number of success claims preceding authoritative successful backend acknowledgement or claiming success for failed/cancelled/superseded tasks; same causal task ID and revision are mandatory.
metrics.artifact_source: Content-free fake backend acknowledgements, causal task IDs, revisions, state transitions and response semantic verdicts; no external action.

metrics.definition: Echo-only opportunities admitted as authoritative user turns after suppression divided by scheduled echo-only opportunities.
metrics.artifact_source: Sanitized events.jsonl with exchange correlation_id, event_id, host_id, clock_id and monotonic_ns; no speech or free-form tags. Pinned exact/fuzzy TTS echo schedules.

metrics.definition: (floor_recovered - component_failure) / 1e6 on target clock for provider/TTS/capture/playback failure; recovery must reach the declared valid floor or bounded terminal shutdown.
metrics.artifact_source: Sanitized events.jsonl with exchange correlation_id, event_id, host_id, clock_id and monotonic_ns; no speech or free-form tags.

metrics.definition: (backchannel_playback_start - model_dispatch) / 1e6 on target clock for an admitted delayed cue; first answer audio remains a distinct metric.
metrics.artifact_source: Sanitized events.jsonl with exchange correlation_id, event_id, host_id, clock_id and monotonic_ns; no speech or free-form tags.

metrics.definition: Required cue cancellations that stop within configured bound and prevent later cue start divided by required cue cancellations.
metrics.artifact_source: Sanitized events.jsonl with exchange correlation_id, event_id, host_id, clock_id and monotonic_ns; no speech or free-form tags. Content-free cue cancellation and playback ownership verdicts.

metrics.definition: Suppressed/fast-response scenarios with an unwanted cue divided by scheduled scenarios in which a cue is forbidden.
metrics.artifact_source: Sanitized events.jsonl with exchange correlation_id, event_id, host_id, clock_id and monotonic_ns; no speech or free-form tags. Declared pacing mode and response-ready schedule.

metrics.definition: Duration of each acoustic overlap interval between stimulus, cue and answer, labelled by stream pair and whether intentionally scheduled. Never merge intentional and unexpected intervals.
metrics.artifact_source: PC monotonic acoustic annotations from pinned synthetic stimulus and isolated response capture; pinned audio retained only in the explicit temporary artifact directory.

metrics.definition: Maximum of zero and end-minus-start test-owned process RSS after warmup and declared quiescence, bytes / 1048576; retain raw signed delta and peak separately per host.
metrics.artifact_source: Owned-process RSS baseline/end observations in resources.jsonl.

metrics.definition: Maximum of zero and end-minus-start count of test-owned threads after bounded quiescence; retain raw inventories and leaked_workers separately.
metrics.artifact_source: Content-free owned-thread inventories before/after stress.

metrics.definition: Maximum of zero and end-minus-start count of test-owned child processes after bounded quiescence; retain raw ownership inventories and leaked_workers separately.
metrics.artifact_source: Content-free owned-process inventories before/after stress.

metrics.definition: Count of concurrent owners of each declared target capture device on lifecycle events; exactly one while capturing, zero after cleanup. Ownership requirements are assertions in addition to the upper-bound metric.
metrics.artifact_source: Content-free device role and owner lifecycle counters; explicit selected device IDs remain in environment manifest.
